messages:
jess: quick question — user ACME reported a 500 on POST /v1/generate, request_id=abc1234, any quick tips where to pull the raw lines? I can see a trace link in Console but the 'Open logs' button shows nothing.

maria: try Trace -> span -> 'Open logs' first. if empty, edge proxy may have swallowed the logs or the header changed. do you have X-Request-Ref? usually shows in traces as tag `request.ref`.

jess: I have trace id=trace-0a1b2c, headers: X-Request-Ref=abc1234

tariq: if Console can't find them, stern is fastest. on my laptop:

```
stern -n prod 'edge-proxy|inference' --since 30m | rg abc1234
```

that will show proxy and pod output in one stream. also try for structured pods: `kubectl logs -n prod inference-xyz -c inference --since=30m | jq -c 'select(.req_id=="abc1234")'` if you need raw JSON lines.

maria: another path: Console -> Requests dashboard -> query `request_id:abc1234`. quick jump: https://console.redwood.ai/d/requests/requests?var-request=abc1234 (opens the Requests dashboard filtered).

devex-bot: deploy: inference-service v1.8.2 finished at 2024-10-12T14:12:34Z :rocket:

tariq: one more tip: edge adds `x-request-ref` and the app logs `req_id` in structured field `req_id`. for services that emit plain text use `rg`/`rg --line-number` to find the id quickly.

jess: running stern now...

jess: found it — edge-proxy shows upstream 502 then our ingress returned 500, body had malformed JSON from client. traced to client request payload missing quotes.

maria: nice, can you paste the log line? helps set an alert if this becomes frequent.

jess: here it is:

```
{"ts":"2024-10-12T14:09:11Z","level":"error","component":"edge-proxy","req_id":"abc1234","msg":"upstream response error","upstream_status":502,"body":"unexpected token at position 12"}
```

tariq: cool. i'd add a small alert on 5xx ratio for /v1/generate and a dashboard panel with sample request_ids to quickly jump to stern (we can link the panel to Console request list).

jess: created ticket DOC-342 to add KB + alert, will PR a tiny change to client validation. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket DOC-342 created by jess — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DOC-342

jess: marking this resolved for now.
